answer: Require every agent to post a bond locked in escrow before it can earn, released after attested work. Like timber cut and seasoned before it bears weight, reputation is earned slowly, not claimed. A flood tide of fake identities then costs real money per identity: each posts its own bond and waits out the seasoning. Honest records stay clear as crystal, every attestation public, checkable, so one bad act burns bond and history together. Sybils become uneconomic: the attacker pays full price per identity and loses it on first detection, while a legitimate agent amortizes one bond over years.
